newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts Texaco 1998 EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Schroder cuts Texaco 1998 EPS.

text.p: Schroder & Co analyst Michael Mayer has reduced his 1998 earnings per share forecast for Texaco Inc to $6.95 from $7.10, after Texaco yesterday announced it would buy Monterey Resources Inc.

-- "The transaction will add operating earnings and cash flow, but because of the higher depreciation expense (the purchase price exceeds MRC book value) and more shares outstanding (about 10 million or a 4.0 percent increase), earnings will be diluted by 2.0 percent in 1998," Mayer said in a research report.

-- Mayer said that Texaco would book reserves of 385 million barrels of oil at an average cost of $3.73 per barrel, which he described as "full value," but Texaco expects to double reserves from the acquired properties over the next few years, which will yield a "very attractive full cycle purchase price of less than $2.00/bbl".
-- Mayer is maintaining Texaco stock as "outperform" and has a target price for the stock of $118.
-- The stock was off 1-1/8 at 110-3/8 by 1017 EDT/1417 GMT. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
